skills.name: daily-journal-api
skills.description: Query Daily Journal's public news API for world news coverage in Portuguese. Use when the user asks about current events globally — politics, economy, business, finance, technology, science, world affairs, sports — or asks for "the latest on X" for any topic, person, or event. Returns structured JSON with cited source outlets. Content is Portuguese (pt-BR).
